WITH trader_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.tr_key,
    tr.typeflag,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(tr.trader_fin_data->>'usd_bal', '[\$, ]', '', 'g')::numeric as balance,
    tr.trader_fin_data->>'risk_lvl' as risk_lvl,
    COALESCE(SUM(trd.vol_day), 0) as daily_volume,
    COALESCE(AVG((trd.trade_perf->>'lev_ratio')::numeric), 0) as avg_lev_ratio
  FROM traders tr
  LEFT JOIN trade_records trd ON trd.tr_anchor = tr.tr_key
  GROUP BY tr.tr_key, tr.typeflag, tr.trader_fin_data
)
SELECT 
  tr_key,
  typeflag,
  balance,
  daily_volume,
  ROUND(CAST(daily_volume / NULLIF(balance, 0) AS numeric), 4) as dtr,
  ROUND(CAST(avg_lev_ratio AS numeric), 2) as tle,
  CASE 
    WHEN (avg_lev_ratio > 5.0 AND risk_lvl = 'Aggressive') OR (daily_volume / NULLIF(balance, 0) > 0.5) THEN true
    ELSE false
  END as is_high_risk
FROM trader_stats
WHERE (avg_lev_ratio > 5.0 AND risk_lvl = 'Aggressive') OR (daily_volume / NULLIF(balance, 0) > 0.5)
LIMIT 10;
